name: Unone Path Trace
description: Path-traced stills of a project's 3D scene (soft shadows, reflections, sky light) for store pages, trailers and lighting reference, using the same materials, lights and HDR environment as the players.

tools.name: pathtrace.render
tools.title: Render a still
tools.description: Path-trace the scene file (main_scene by default) from its camera to a PNG (renders/still.png by default). Entities as declared in the scene; runtime spawns and lighting changes are not included.

samples.description: Rays per pixel; default 16. More is smoother and slower.
